Title: Azure SQL—General availability updates for mid-November 2022

Body.Content:
In mid-November 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Monitor database restore progress at a more granular level in Azure SQL Database. 
  • Provide additional transparency for automated and manually taken backups via SQL Server Management Studio using the msdb backupset tables with Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Migrate to Azure SQL Managed Instance using Log Replay Service. 
  • Enable cross-subscription Point-In-Time restore of Azure SQL Managed Instance database in a safe and protected way.
